messages.subject: For Ricardo Ramos | Lithium growth, stakeholder strategy and responsible execution
messages.body:
Dear SQM Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Ricardo Ramos, Chief Executive Officer.

SQM's global lithium platform places government relationships, community confidence, environmental stewardship and strategic partnerships close to long-term growth. Those interfaces are especially important as critical-minerals investment expands and stakeholder expectations increase.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My work combines government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory across a major mining operation. I also support stakeholder governance around industrial renewable-energy infrastructure and carbon-accounting evidence work.

I would value a senior conversation about where this operating-side experience might support SQM's stakeholder, sustainability, government-relations or international-growth priorities. My attached CV is tailored specifically to that contribution.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
